This assumption was incorrect because the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School is not Cleveland Park but rather a station on the Green Line (Shaw-Howard University or Mt. Vernon Square). The error led to an incorrect determination of the number of stops and the final solution to the problem. This mistake was introduced in Step 6 when the Orchestrator prematurely decided that the answer was "0" without correcting the incorrect station identification.
